other_conditions: Indian citizens above the age of 60 years
Retirees aged 55‑60 years who have opted for Voluntary Retirement Scheme (VRS) or Superannuation
Retired defense personnel aged above 50 years and below 60 years
Investment must be made within a month of availing retirement benefits
benefits_summary: Provides a high‑interest, government‑backed savings option for senior citizens with tax deductions under Section 80C.
